name: Hexbotica
detailed_description:
Strategize, Overcome, Dominate.

Do you love turn based strategy games but prefer quicker matches packed with depth? Dive into streamlined tactical battles across three distinct battle layers Ground, Sky, and Underground. Whether ambushing enemies from cloud cover, fortifying high ground to stall enemy advances, or mining hidden resources underground, each decision carries weight. Simple to learn yet rich with strategic possibilities, this game offers engaging gameplay without lengthy commitments.

Key Features

Triple-Layered Warfare:

  • Ground Layer: Control the terrain by claiming high ground, granting movement and strategic advantages. Navigate carefully hills slow your ascent but speed your descent.

  • Sky Layer: Engage in fast-paced aerial combat, maneuvering around dynamic clouds that shift each turn and slow your movement, adding another layer of tactical challenge. Dominate the skies for significant strategic superiority.

  • Underground Layer: Mine valuable resources to rapidly expand your economy. Beware the underground fog resets each turn, concealing potential ambushes.

Diverse Units:

  • Cube Bot: Reliable and affordable standard infantry unit.

  • Builder: Constructs defensive Walls, Turrets, and Teleporters to gain the advantage.

  • Flyer: Basic air unit specialized in aerial engagements. Its scanning ability reveals hidden units on the ground, providing critical intel for planning strategic attacks.

  • Bomber: Attacks ground units.

  • Miner: Mines through walls underground to reach new areas and places explosive mines underground and on the surface, creating strategic choke points.

  • Tank: Powerful but slow, ideal for heavy assaults and long-range engagements, particularly effective on flat terrain.

  • Terraformer: Strategically alters terrain elevation to create high-ground advantages or to block enemy routes and constructs roads to accelerate your units' movement.

  • Teleporter: Teleports units to other teleporters.

  • Collector: Collects gems to enable creation and upgrading of your units.

  • Silo: Launches Missiles to attack enemy sky units.

Defensive Structures:

  • Walls: Sturdy barriers built by Builders to halt enemy progress.

  • Mines: Explosive traps deployed by Miners, devastating to unsuspecting foes.

  • Turrets: Stationary ranged units with slow reload but high burst damage.

Unlock more units and defensive tools to enhance your strategic capabilities. Each match presents unique challenges, ensuring that every battle is fresh and rewarding.

Prepare your strategies, master the terrain, and claim victory!
